raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: cog3pio
  python_min: "3.13"
  version: 0.1.0
  target_type: ${{ "x86_64-linux" if (linux and x86_64) else "sbsa-linux" }}

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/cog3pio-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7a84fc884d7dacaec2d7cab28f83e700a70d5197b43df002bb2f2a3e34bcf0e3

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO: fat
    content:
      - if: ppc64le
        then:
          # Rust 1.90 uses lld by default and has issue linking to conda libraries
          # compiled with newer gcc
          - export RUSTFLAGS="$RUSTFLAGS -C link-arg=-fuse-ld=bfd"
      - if: linux and (x86_64 or aarch64)
        then:
          - sed --in-place "s/nvtiffTagDataType type/enum nvtiffTagDataType type/g" $BUILD_PREFIX/include/nvtiff.h
          - ln -s $BUILD_PREFIX/include/nvtiff.h $BUILD_PREFIX/targets/${{ target_type }}/include/nvtiff.h;
          - ln -s $BUILD_PREFIX/include/nvtiff_version.h $BUILD_PREFIX/targets/${{ target_type }}/include/nvtiff_version.h;
          - ln -s $BUILD_PREFIX/lib/libnvtiff.so $BUILD_PREFIX/targets/${{ target_type }}/lib/libnvtiff.so;
          - export RUSTFLAGS="-L$BUILD_PREFIX/targets/${{ target_type }}/lib"
          - export BINDGEN_EXTRA_CLANG_ARGS="-I $BUILD_PREFIX/targets/${{ target_type }}/include"
          - export MATURIN_PEP517_ARGS="--features cuda,pyo3"
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    version_independent: true
  skip:
    - not ((match(python, python_min ~ ".*") and is_abi3) or is_freethreading)
    - ppc64le and is_freethreading

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - maturin >=1.12,<2.0
        - python
    - if: linux and (x86_64 or aarch64)
      then:
        - clangdev
        - cuda-cudart-dev
        - cuda-crt
        - libnvtiff-dev 0.7.*
  host:
    - maturin >=1.12,<2.0
    - pip
    - python
    - if: is_abi3
      then: python-abi3
  run:
    - numpy >=2.0
    - python
    - if: is_freethreading
      then: python-freethreading
    - if: linux and (x86_64 or aarch64)
      then: libnvtiff 0.7.*

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - cog3pio
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - if: is_abi3
          then: ${{ python_min ~ '.*' }}
        - "*"
  - script:
      - python -c "import cog3pio; assert cog3pio.__version__ == '${{ version }}', cog3pio.__version__"
      - if: linux and (x86_64 or aarch64)
        then: python -c "from cog3pio import CudaCogReader"
      - if: unix and is_abi3
        then: abi3audit $SP_DIR/cog3pio/cog3pio.abi3.so -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
      - if: win and is_abi3
        then: abi3audit %SP_DIR%\\cog3pio\\cog3pio.pyd -s -v --assume-minimum-abi3 ${{ python_min }}
      # Needed to avoid "expected field `script` to be a list of commands" on is_freethreading
      - if: not is_abi3
        then: true
    requirements:
      run:
        - if: is_abi3
          then:
            - abi3audit

about:
  homepage: https://cog3pio.readthedocs.io
  repository: https://github.com/weiji14/cog3pio
  summary: "Cloud-optimized GeoTIFF ... Parallel I/O"
  license: Apache-2.0 OR MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE-APACHE
    - LICENSE-MIT
    - THIRDPARTY.yml

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - weiji14

script: python -c "import cog3pio; assert cog3pio.__version__ == '${{ version }}', cog3pio.__version__"
python -c "import cog3pio; assert cog3pio.__version__ == '${{ version }}', cog3pio.__version__"
